items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: He told me he played with Jimmy Gunn and they recorded one of his tunes

ctx.x: He was a good medium. He would take you to the musician, the way you'd be with him. I know him, though. You remember Herman, too, huh?
Yeah. He told me he played with Jimmy Gunn and they recorded one of his tunes to my levy home.
I've been hunting for that record ever since. Kildee, you mean? No, Herman Franklin. Oh, yeah.
